userGoal: A visible useful improvement, with preserved expression, on the existing native person.

diagnosis.priorFailureCause: Native orbit.update introduced a last-place target-coordinate difference. Exact references are now reapplied after the native update. Strict camera and state comparisons remain enabled.

observations.finding: Segmented inner-edge strips survive removal of procedural bump; small silhouette steps survive albedo-only rendering.
observations.inference: Procedural bump or wetness alone cannot account for the visible defect. Geometry and its surface responsibility must be checked.

observations.finding: Removing native local actions reduces the strips. The three sampled upper strips contain both upper:true and upper:false native samples on the same visible return surface.
observations.inference: Native local action directions can pull neighboring inner-surface samples oppositely. A bounded tissue-ownership correction is justified.
observations.uncertainty: CPU projected triangles are geometric attribution with explicit MSAA uncertainty, not exact GPU fragment ownership.

observations.finding: The no-local image is byte-identical to the previous R04 jaw-only image.
observations.rejectedShortcut: Disabling the local action is not a repair even if declared pose numbers remain unchanged. Actual expression geometry must be retained.

observations.finding: No-local widens and weakens the pucker. No-closure separates the central lip edges and exposes a broader tooth strip while corner folds persist.
observations.rejectedShortcut: Removing pucker or closure is not a fix for corner mechanics or a natural lip seal.

candidateContract.owns: Evaluated native inner-return-surface action direction; continuous tissue following.
mustDemonstrate: visible benefit at the native comparison size
actual expression remains distinct from jaw-only ablation
neutral and jaw poses do not regress
intermediate expression states do not jump
off reproduces the independently loaded immutable R04
fresh archived person reproduces the original candidate frame
rejectionConditions: better appearance caused only by weaker expression
numbers pass but visible improvement is negligible

scope: This bounded repair does not establish complete anatomical understanding or complete lip realism.
